headline: CJP to Draft Citizens' Manifesto for Goa
summary: The Centre for Justice and Peace has announced plans to draft a Citizens' Manifesto for Goa. The proposed document will include demands to scrap Section 39A.

headline: CJP Accuses Goa Administration of Tribal Land Grab
summary: CJP activist Abhijeet Dipke has accused the Goa state administration of illegally seizing tribal lands. He raised concerns over land rights and identity preservation in the state.

headline: CJP Announces Public Meeting in Panaji
summary: CJP representatives Abhijeet Dipke and Saurav Das have announced a public gathering in Panaji under the banner 'Kya Bolti Goa'. The event aims to address local social and political concerns.

headline: 57th IFFI Begins in Goa with Grand Ceremony
summary: The 57th edition of the International Film Festival of India has commenced in Goa with a grand opening ceremony. The festival brings together global cinema and film industry personalities.

headline: IFFI Day 2 Highlights Classic Films and Open-Air Screenings
summary: The second day of IFFI in Goa featured classic cinema revivals alongside open-air movie screenings. Film enthusiasts gathered across venues to celebrate world cinema.

headline: Russian Film 'New Home' Explores Post-Prison Life at IFFI
summary: A Russian filmmaker's movie titled 'New Home' was showcased at IFFI, focusing on post-prison rehabilitation struggles. The film highlights the emotional challenges of reintegrating into society.

headline: ELIVAAS Expands Luxury Villa Portfolio in Vagator
summary: Hospitality brand ELIVAAS has expanded its Goa presence by adding 11 private pool villas in Vagator. The addition enhances luxury stay options for high-end travelers visiting the area.

headline: Film Stars and Musicians Feature at IFFI Opening
summary: Actors Sai Pallavi and Ravi Kishan along with Grammy winner Ricky Kej attended the grand opening of IFFI in Goa. The stars shared anecdotes and musical performances during the event.

headline: North Goa Panchayats Study Chinchinim's Development Initiatives
summary: Representatives from North Goa panchayats visited Chinchinim to inspect local development projects and village initiatives. The study tour aims to replicate effective rural governance practices.

headline: CJP Vows to Protect Goa's Land and Identity
summary: CJP leader Abhijeet Dipke reiterated the organization's commitment to defending Goa's land and local identity. He strongly advocated for the immediate repeal of Section 39A.

headline: CJP Criticizes Chief Minister Over Land Sales
summary: Activist Abhijeet Dipke attacked the Goa Chief Minister, accusing the state leadership of favoring outside commercial interests over locals. He claimed land and resources are being transferred away from residents.

headline: CJP Alleges Attack on Villagers Opposing Housing Project
summary: CJP activist Abhijeet Dipke claimed that villagers protesting against a controversial housing project in Goa were physically assaulted. He demanded swift legal action against those responsible for the violence.

headline: Goa Eases Sanad Rules for Rebuilding Old Houses
summary: The Goa government has relaxed conversion sanad rules to provide relief to residents rebuilding old structures. The policy shift simplifies property procedures for homeowners.

headline: Assamese Documentary 'Red Carpet' Screened at IFFI
summary: The Assamese documentary 'Red Carpet' was featured at the International Film Festival of India in Goa. The film highlights the rich handloom heritage of the Karbi community.

headline: CJP Claims Goa's Cultural Identity Is Under Threat
summary: The Centre for Justice and Peace asserted that Goa's distinct culture and regional identity are facing continuous attacks. The organization promised to mobilize public support to resist harmful policies.

headline: J&K Information Department Represents State at 57th IFFI
summary: The Department of Information and Public Relations represented Jammu & Kashmir at the 57th International Film Festival of India in Goa. The participation showcased J&K's film potential and cultural heritage.

headline: Public Outreach Campaign 'Kya Bolti Public' Launched in Goa
summary: A public outreach campaign titled 'Kya Bolti Public' has been launched across Goa to engage local citizens. The initiative aims to collect feedback on civic and developmental issues.

headline: 12 Goan Films Showcased at International Film Festival
summary: A collection of 12 Goan films exploring themes of family, regional identity, and local life beyond tourist beaches is being featured at IFFI. The showcase highlights authentic Goan cinema.

headline: AAP Outreach Meeting Disrupted at Moti Dongor
summary: An 'AAP Ki Chai' public interaction event organized by the Aam Aadmi Party at Moti Dongor faced disruptions. Organizers expressed concern over political interference targeting their outreach.

headline: Curtorim Farmers Urged to Preserve Native Seeds
summary: Agricultural advocates in Curtorim have encouraged local farmers to collect and save indigenous seed varieties. The initiative seeks to protect traditional agricultural practices and crop diversity.

headline: Quiet Goa Spots Highlighted for Peaceful Escapes
summary: A curated list of tranquil locations across Goa encourages tourists to experience quiet retreats away from noisy nightlife. These destinations offer opportunities for rest and relaxation.

headline: Rs 7-Crore GIS Portal Planned for Mandovi River Quality
summary: Goa plans to set up a Rs 7-crore GIS-based water quality monitoring portal for the Mandovi River. Modeled after the Ganga project, it will track river pollution levels systematically.

headline: Goa Government Overhauls Ration Card System
summary: The Goa state government has issued a new order updating the public ration card distribution system. The overhaul aims to streamline food grain allocation and remove ineligible entries.

headline: Missing Land Records Will Not Stop Sanad Approvals
summary: Goa has relaxed administrative rules so that minor gaps in historical land records will no longer block sanad conversion applications. The move aims to resolve long-pending property files for citizens.

headline: 57th IFFI Opens Celebrating Global Cinema
summary: The 57th International Film Festival of India opened in Goa, celebrating diverse storytelling traditions from across the globe. International delegates and filmmakers gathered for the multi-day festival.

headline: Margao Celebrates 117th Annual Dindi Festival
summary: Thousands of devotees gathered in Margao to celebrate the 117th annual Dindi festival marked by devotional bhajans. The event brought locals together in a traditional display of faith.

headline: Survey Shows 25% Undecided Voters in Goa
summary: A political survey revealed that one in four voters in Goa remains undecided ahead of upcoming elections. The findings suggest a closely contested race across key constituencies.

headline: Churchill Brothers Aim to Break Winless Streak
summary: Churchill Brothers FC are preparing for their upcoming fixture with a focus on securing three points. The Goan club is seeking to reverse a recent run of poor results.

headline: Panaji Records Season's Lowest Temperature at 18.3°C
summary: Panaji recorded a sharp dip in temperature as the thermometer dropped to 18.3°C, which is 4.3°C below normal. Cool weather conditions are expected to continue across the state.

headline: Concerns Raised Over Post-Festival Littering in Goa
summary: A local commentary raised concerns over large quantities of garbage left behind in public spaces after public celebrations in Goa. The piece calls for improved civic responsibility and waste disposal.

headline: Falling Tree Damages Parked Scooter in Morlem
summary: A parked scooter sustained heavy damage after a tree collapsed on it in Morlem. No injuries were reported during the incident.

headline: Political Rivals Attend Margao Dindi Festival
summary: The annual Dindi festival in Margao saw leaders from both ruling and opposition parties come together under one roof. Politicians set aside rivalries to join the traditional celebration.

headline: 1,700 Goa Teachers to Screen Students for Vision Care
summary: Goa's Chief Minister announced that 1,717 schoolteachers will be trained to conduct vision screenings for students under the 'Vision for All' project. The drive aims to detect eye problems early.

headline: Young Music Students Perform at Agonda Event
summary: Music students demonstrated their talents during a showcase event held in Agonda. The performance highlighted local youth trained in classical and contemporary music.

headline: Child Rights Body Moves to Activate Village Protection Units
summary: The Goa State Commission for Protection of Child Rights has initiated steps to activate child protection committees at the village level. The measure seeks to strengthen child welfare networks.

headline: Benaulim Activist's House Targeted in Second Attack
summary: Unidentified miscreants launched a second attack targeting the residence of a local activist in Benaulim. Police have initiated an investigation into the vandalism.

headline: Congress Faces Credibility Test for 2027 Goa Elections
summary: The Congress party in Goa faces a test of credibility as leadership plans ticket selection for the 2027 assembly elections. Cadres are demanding a fair process for candidate selection.

headline: NFDC and Sony Launch Content Creator Initiative at IFFI
summary: The National Film Development Corporation and Sony Pictures Network India launched a submission initiative for content creators at IFFI in Goa. The effort aims to discover new creative talent.

headline: CJP Pledges Support to Goans Fighting Land Exploitation
summary: The Centre for Justice and Peace reaffirmed its commitment to back local residents fighting land exploitation in Goa. The organization pledged to offer legal support for land rights.

headline: Bhopal Police Delay Visit to Goa in Rs 1.9 Crore Scam
summary: Bhopal police have yet to send an investigative team to Goa regarding a financial fraud case involving Rs 1.9 crore. Victims of the scam are awaiting progress in the police probe.

headline: Goa Grants Rs 8 Lakh Relief to Calangute Fire Victims
summary: The Goa government announced Rs 8 lakh financial assistance for four shack operators whose premises were destroyed in a fire on Calangute beach. The compensation will assist in rebuilding their shacks.

headline: Two Booked for Assault and Death Threats in Goa
summary: Goa Police have booked two individuals for physically assaulting a woman and issuing death threats to her. A formal legal investigation into the incident is currently underway.

headline: Carmelites Gather in Old Goa to Honor First Martyrs
summary: Members of the Carmelite order gathered at a historic site in Old Goa to pay tribute to their first martyrs. The religious service brought together clergy and devotees for prayers.

headline: BJP-MGP Pre-Poll Alliance Talks Hit Deadlock
summary: Discussions between the BJP and MGP over a pre-poll alliance in Goa have stalled over seat-sharing disagreements. Both political parties have yet to reach a final agreement.

headline: ACB Raids Suspended Constable's Residence in Valpoi
summary: The Anti-Corruption Bureau conducted a raid on a suspended police constable's residence in Valpoi. The action follows allegations of holding assets disproportionate to legal income sources.

headline: Over 300 Citizens Benefit from Anywhere Registration System
summary: Goa's Chief Minister revealed that over 300 citizens have used the state's Anywhere Registration System for land and document filings. The system aims to simplify official registration processes.

headline: Over 400 Trees to Be Cut for Highway Expansion
summary: More than 400 trees are set to be felled for the widening of the Ponda-Old Goa national highway. Local environmentalists have expressed concern over the planned tree removal.

headline: Bombari Brings Mumbai's Culinary Flavors to Goa
summary: A feature highlights Bombari, bringing Mumbai's nostalgic culinary flavors and coastal recipes to Goa's food scene. The eatery focuses on authentic Mumbai-style preparations.

headline: Nearly 1,000 Devotees Join Catholic Procession
summary: Around 1,000 Catholic faithful participated in a devotional religious procession held in Goa. The event saw active involvement from community members across different age groups.

headline: Coach Viadero Focuses on Positives Ahead of NorthEast United Match
summary: FC Goa coach Manolo Viadero expressed confidence ahead of their upcoming match against NorthEast United. He emphasized carrying forward positive momentum from recent team performances.
